question: Why is gross embodiment not distinctly perceived at this level?
premises: The kalas beginning with Nivritti are extremely subtle.
Because of that subtlety, embodiment beginning from earth is not formed in the usual way.
The Mother is absorbed in flashing great knowledge, so differentiation is not distinctly perceived.
inference: At this level, subtlety and absorption in supreme knowledge prevent the clear manifestation of gross embodiment.
uncertainties: The compound is dense; the causal chain is inferred from standard doctrinal phrasing.
plain_english: Because Nivritti and the other kalas are extremely subtle, embodiment beginning from earth does not take shape in the usual way. Since the Mother is absorbed in flashing great knowledge, it is not distinctly perceived.
